scenes.text: Every night, a small window lit up in the valley.
And every night, a light on the far hill answered.
For years, they blinked to each other. No words. Just light.
Then one night, the far light didn't come on.
The small window stayed lit anyway. Night after night.
Until one cold night... a new light answered.

end: Keep your light on. Someone out there is looking for it.
